intent: One row of a menu or menu-toolbar. Type-driven anatomy: a reserved checkmark slot and a leading-icon slot, plus heading / divider / toolbar / footer shapes.
use_when: Composing a menu's contents (inside Menu / a popover surface).
type="toolbar" for a row of inline icon buttons; type="checkmark" for a selectable option with a reserved check column.
dont_use_when: You need the menu container / positioning — use Menu.
A standalone action outside a menu — use Button.

slots.leading: Leading slot (check / switch / icon). Reserved even when empty so labels align.
slots.children: toolbar / footer content (inline buttons or actions).

a11y.role: menuitem (interactive); menuitemradio / menuitemcheckbox when selectionRole is set; heading and divider are non-interactive.
a11y.disabledReason: surfaced as visible text and associated via aria-describedby.
a11y.submenu: hasSubmenu sets aria-haspopup / aria-expanded / aria-controls on the trigger row.

code.example:
<MenuRow type="checkmark" label="Snap to pixels" checked selectionRole="checkbox" onClick={toggle} />
<MenuRow type="toolbar">
  <IconButton … /><IconButton … />
</MenuRow>
